purpose: Authenticate the user-copied receipt to the already sealed formal package, then its complete provenance bytes, exporting only selected receipt hashes and six TRAIN circuits' 24 source-metadata rows.
stable_read: Plain regular non-reparse single-link files only. Check path metadata before open, file-descriptor metadata before read, both after read, exact length and bounds. Same-API identity compares dev/ino/mode/nlink/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns fully. Only Windows cross-API path-vs-FD comparison omits ctime_ns, as E52 established; same-API ctime changes still reject. Reparse checks apply before and after reads.
binding_order: Stable read exact receipt and check full-byte SHA before JSON key or selected-value decoding.
Byte syntax projector decodes field names plus ONLY schema_version and sha256.source_provenance/candidate_space/normalized_measurements; never semantic values of ignored receipt fields.
Require schema formal-candidate-space-v2-receipt, aggregate candidate and normalized pins, and exact provenance SHA field before opening the provenance file.
Stable read complete provenance metadata, verify its full-byte SHA before any TSV field decoding.
Validate exact header/flat-row byte grammar; compare first-cell bytes against six TRAIN names; only selected fields are decoded.
grid: Exactly one row for each six-TRAIN-circuit x four-builder-stage pair. Unknown stage aliases, duplicates or incomplete grid reject. Do not assume total provenance row count; non-TRAIN rows remain byte-only and excluded count is explicit.
tsv_byte_policy: Six unquoted columns (five tabs), LF records, no blank interior records, quotes, CR/control bytes or ambiguous multiline records. Non-TRAIN value bytes may be non-ASCII and are never decoded. Selected TRAIN rows must be ASCII with 64-lowerhex source/normalized SHA, bounded canonical decimal row_count and exact stage-compatible basename.

ordinal_namespace.logical_ordinal: One-based data-row ordinal in original provenance, excluding header and including skipped non-TRAIN rows.
ordinal_namespace.physical_line: One-based original physical line number, header included; physical_line=logical_ordinal+1.
ordinal_namespace.order: Preserve original selected-row order; never sort or renumber after filtering.

output: Complete metadata-file hashes/byte sizes and paths, four receipt projection fields, selected24 source metadata rows with both ordinals, exclusion/scan counts and safety flags. No raw receipt/provenance, non-TRAIN values, quality tables or source snapshot contents.
verification_gate: Worker performs synthetic tests only. Parent independent review and gate are required before the fixed-path actual projection. No actual copied metadata content has been read by this implementation worker.
